comment: The LHR is placed in the foundational shared data layer alongside authoritative registries. Unlike the registries, however, it contains or provides access to person-level clinical information generated through operational care processes. Its inclusion in the same layer requires stronger justification.

public.text: The LHR is placed in the foundational shared data layer alongside authoritative registries. Unlike the registries, however, it contains or provides access to person-level clinical information generated through operational care processes. Its inclusion in the same layer requires stronger justification.
public.suggestedRevision: Explain that the LHR is included because it provides a reusable longitudinal health-information capability across programmes, not because it is a metadata registry. Visually distinguish it from authoritative entity registries within the foundational layer.
